status.summary: The City of Mesa's public building-inspection records for 10464 E Pecos Rd show city inspectors approving or partially approving construction work on both AWS PHX065 data-centre building permits in the 85 days to 22 October 2026. On PMT24-15709 ('Data Center Bldg 2', a 229,416 sq ft single-storey data center) they recorded framing, mechanical rough-in, above-ceiling, drywall fire-assembly and electrical rough-in inspections between 3 August and 12 October 2026. On PMT25-13554 ('Data Center Bldg B', a second 229,416 sq ft single-storey data center) they recorded pre-slab, electric underground, drywall shear-assembly, framing, electrical rough-in and footing inspections between 3 August and 22 October 2026, the latest a footing partial approval on 22 October 2026. This records the two buildings as under construction on 22 October 2026. Partial approvals cover the inspected portions only; no certificate of occupancy has been recorded, and completion, operation, IT capacity and customers are not established.
